says: A run with no catalog fails with Effect's path, not KALFA_QUALITY_STRYKER_CATALOG, though the plan's settings table, the README's settings table and this doc comment all say it names the variable; law Q7 only checks that the word 'catalog' appears, so it cannot see this.
proof: Settings.all.parse(Settings.provider({}, {})) printed `Failure(Cause([Fail(ConfigError(SchemaError(Expected string\n  at ["quality"]["stryker"]["catalog"])))]))`; Settings.test.ts asserts only `String(none).toLowerCase()).toContain("catalog")`, while kalfa/quality/README.md's settings table says 'a run without one fails naming this variable'.
cost: A person who runs the package without the repo's edge is told a value is missing at an internal path, not which variable to set.
